name: Elite Fabrication and Welding LLC
old_description: We are a family owned and operated fabrication shop since 1980 with over 30 years of experience in building quality products.
about:
Elite Fabrication and Welding LLC operates from West Haven, Utah, where it has been a family-owned and operated fabrication shop since 1980. The company was founded on a commitment to building quality products, accumulating over three decades of experience in custom metalwork.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication from design through finish, specializing in welding across stainless steel, aluminum, and mild steel. Its service lineup includes metal shearing, punching, bending, hydraulic press forming, plasma cutting, and on-site installation and fabrication. The company also manufactures its own product, the Elite Pull, a foot-operated door handle designed to reduce hand contact.

Elite Fabrication serves customers worldwide, though the website does not specify particular industry sectors or named clients. Its capabilities are positioned for jobs of any size, from small custom parts to larger structural projects.

The company emphasizes its certification in all welding applications and its ability to handle diverse projects with professionalism, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. Its long-standing presence and family ownership are presented as foundations for reliable service.

The firm provides custom fabrication of stainless steel and exotic metal structures, offering services that include architectural metalwork, precision machining, structural design, specialized coatings, industrial welding, equipment installation, on-site fabrication, and advanced fabrication planning. It also handles commercial construction, innovative design projects, project oversight, custom infrastructure solutions, and precision engineering. The company reports more than 500 completed projects and partnerships with over 15 industry collaborators.

Elite Metal Fabricators serves clients in healthcare, education, and public infrastructure, with concrete project examples including hospitals, universities, community buildings, zoos, international airports, shopping malls, and large-scale commercial and infrastructure developments.

The company emphasizes transparency, open communication, and integrity as core values, positioning its commitment to quality and tailored solutions as key differentiators. Its vision centers on crafting excellence in every structure to create possibilities for clients and communities.

name: Elite Woodworking
old_description: At Elite Woodworking our devotion is to the finest craftsmanship of custom cabinet doors and drawer fronts. Imagination takes form as the designer's ideas are brought to life by the hands of our skilled artisans. We believe your dreams define the quality of our products regardless of personal style and taste. Elite Woodworking emphasizes the unparalleled beauty and elegance of natural wood design choices for every room in your home. Your custom designs, combined with our artistic visions create beautiful kitchens, bathrooms and other areas of your home.
about:
Elite Woodworking was founded in 1990 in Phoenix, Arizona, by Dan Walker after he completed an apprenticeship at Wilson Custom Cabinets in 1982 and worked for a small custom cabinet shop for two additional years. The company remains family-owned and operated from its facility, where it moved in 1999 after initially renting space within an existing cabinet shop.

The shop manufactures custom cabinet doors and drawer fronts, along with mouldings, hardware, and carved details. Its product range includes cope-and-stick, mitered, and French-light door styles, multiple panel and edge profiles, and a variety of wood species. With a team of about ten skilled craftsmen, Elite Woodworking produces doors for over 100 cabinet makers and private clients across Arizona.

Customers include residential cabinet shops, interior designers, homeowners remodeling kitchens and bathrooms, and commercial offices; the company also supplies Habitat for Humanity projects. Orders range from single replacement doors to full kitchen suites, and the firm offers design assistance and eco-friendly lumber options for each project.

Elite Woodworking emphasizes that every door is built in its Arizona facility and guarantees that custom orders meet exact size and specification requirements. The founder’s original goal was to provide top-quality craftsmanship with a wide assortment of styles, a mission that continues to guide the business today.

name: Elk Grove Custom Sheet Metal
old_description: We specialize in custom fabrication, full-service welding, industrial ventilation, and design & installation services. Whatever your project requires, we have the equipment and experience to get it done right.
about:
Elk Grove Custom Sheet Metal has operated from Elk Grove Village, Illinois, since 1989. The family‑owned shop was founded to serve industrial businesses in the O’Hare corridor and the greater Chicago area, and it remains under family ownership today.

The company provides custom sheet metal fabrication, full‑service welding (MIG, TIG, and stick), industrial ventilation systems including custom ductwork and exhaust systems, and design‑to‑installation services for plant‑floor equipment such as conveyors, machine guards, and hoppers. It also builds stainless‑steel tables, shelving, and carts for food‑production and clean‑manufacturing environments, and offers reverse‑engineering from samples or sketches.

Its customers span food and candy production, packaging and printing, industrial equipment maintenance, rubber and plastics, and general manufacturing. The shop focuses on manufacturers in Elk Grove Village and the surrounding O’Hare business corridor.

The firm emphasizes its family‑owned structure and a commitment to giving every job — large or small — the same attention to detail, positioning itself as a single point of contact from design through on‑site installation.

name: Emcee Electronics Inc
old_description: We make instruments to measure electrical conductivity, water separability, and filterability of explosive liquids.
about:
Emcee Electronics Inc. operates from Venice, Florida, where it designs and manufactures instruments for measuring the electrical conductivity, water separability, and filterability of explosive liquids. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in public materials.

Its product line consists of test instruments that conform to standard methods published by ASTM International, the Energy Institute (formerly the Institute of Petroleum), and ISO. The devices are used to evaluate fuel quality and safety, particularly in aviation and petroleum applications. Emcee Electronics does not publish facility size, headcount, or production volumes.

The company serves customers through a dealer network and emphasizes compliance with industry standards. Its instruments are referenced in ASTM, IP/EI, and ISO specifications, indicating use in aviation fuel testing, petroleum product certification, and related quality-control laboratories. A recent announcement notes that Emcee Electronics joined PAC to accelerate service to global customers.

Emcee Electronics highlights its ISO 9001:2015 certification as evidence of quality management across production. It also publishes technical white papers—such as an analysis of ASTM D8073 test method limitations—and provides training videos and instruction manuals to support end users.

name: Emerald Steel Fabricators Inc
old_description: has been fabricating structural and mechanical projects, machining, sandblasting and painting since 1975.
about:
Emerald Steel Fabricators Inc was founded in 1975 in Eugene, Oregon, as a family-owned fabrication shop. The company began by fabricating structural and mechanical projects, machining, sandblasting, and painting, and has remained under family ownership for over four decades.

Today the firm operates a full-service machine and fabrication shop on a five-acre industrial site with 25,400 square feet of shop space, including an enclosed paint and sandblast facility. Its capabilities span structural steel fabrication meeting AISC/AWS specifications, mechanical fabrication, CNC and manual machining, welding, assembly, and finishing. The shop runs a CNC beam line for cutting and punching beams, channels, angles, and tees, as well as a CNC drill line, supported by a large array of CNC and manual machines.

Emerald Steel serves contractors and other industrial customers, often stepping in for hot-rush jobs and R&D projects. The company emphasizes repeat business from clients who rely on its ability to handle complex fabrications and tight schedules.

The company differentiates itself by offering complete in-house production from raw steel to finished, painted assemblies, allowing customers to bid larger jobs without adding staff. Its team focuses on problem-solving and cost-effective manufacturing, with machining capabilities described as among the most diverse in the Willamette Valley.

name: EnaChip Inc.
old_description: In 2013 he returned to Penn to become the Alfred Fitler Moore Professor and Director of Penn’s Singh Center for Nanotechnology. In 2024 he became Chair of Penn’s Department of Electrical and Systems Engineering. Mark’s research is in the area of microelectromechanical systems (MEMS). Beginning with a plenary address to the 1994 IEEE Applied Power Engineering Conference on the topic of integrated inductors, and continuing through today, a major thrust of his program is the realization of microfabricated magnetics for advanced power delivery. He has chaired or co-chaired multiple conferences and co-founded multiple MEMS companies.
about:
EnaChip Inc. is based in Rocky Hill, New Jersey. The company develops and manufactures magnetics for high-frequency power conversion, with a focus on AI data center infrastructure.

The company produces bespoke magnetics—including multilayer inductors and wafer-level arrays—that enable vertical power delivery for 800V DC architectures. Its fabrication process uses electroplating on standard semiconductor equipment to create thick copper planar windings and high-flux-density cores, achieving low DC resistance and efficient switching above 10 MHz. Devices range from single ~1 mm components to wafer-level arrays, integrating with GaN and advanced silicon switches.

EnaChip targets operators and designers of AI data centers and high-performance computing systems where power delivery losses are a primary constraint. Its technology addresses the last-centimeter conversion and routing losses between voltage regulators and processor dies. The company also lists energy harvesting and energy conversion among its served markets.

EnaChip states that its electroplated core stacks cut manufacturing time dramatically and that its parts drop into any level of a design stack—board, package, or die. The company emphasizes that power delivery should enable performance rather than limit it, positioning its magnetics as a way to unlock the capabilities of next-generation switches.

name: Encompass Manufacturing
old_description: After 35 years in the Plastic Injection Molding industry, we can handle even the most complex projects and would love the opportunity to address your molding needs.
about:
Encompass Manufacturing operates from Cookeville, Tennessee, where it was founded over 35 years ago by Ricky Sherrell as Putnam County Plastic Molding. The company is certified as a Women's Business Enterprise through WBENC and is now led by President Samantha Sherrell, with Ricky Sherrell serving as vice president.

The firm specializes in plastic injection molding supported by a full-service tool shop and a range of secondary operations including sonic welding, hot stamping, screen printing, pad printing, insert molding, vibratory welding, drilling, and assembly. Its press lineup spans 125 to 1,214 tons, enabling production of complex components from engineering-grade resins. A proprietary Mattec/MVP system provides real-time scheduling, inventory tracking, and preventive maintenance data, while an on-site metrology lab offers calibration and inspection services.

Customers range from small startups to major automotive suppliers worldwide. The company's quality system, certified to ISO 9001, incorporates Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), and full traceability from raw material to final assembly.

Encompass emphasizes a quality-first culture rooted in honesty, reliability, and continuous improvement, aiming to deliver complete part solutions from a single location.

name: Enercon Engineering LLC, A Generac Company
old_description: Enercon specializes in Low-Voltage and Medium-Voltage Switchgear,
about:
Enercon Engineering began over four decades ago in a 5,000-square-foot garage in Peoria, Illinois. The company grew into a 160,000-square-foot manufacturing campus in East Peoria, adding a 50,000-square-foot electrical assembly area, an in-house sheet metal fabrication shop, a military-standard paint booth, and on-site load-testing capacity for power generation systems. In April 2026, Enercon was acquired by Generac, a global energy technology leader, to expand manufacturing strength and data-center market presence.

Enercon designs and manufactures precision-engineered low- and medium-voltage switchgear (up to 15 kV), UL 508A and UL 698A industrial control panels, generator docking stations (400–4,000 amp), sound-attenuated generator enclosures, and mobile power packaging systems. The vertically integrated operation handles electrical and mechanical engineering, custom fabrication, system integration, PLC/HMI programming, and full functional and load testing. The company reports more than 50,000 projects deployed across 110 countries and has added capacity for an additional 1,000-plus docking stations per year.

Customers span data centers, defense and military programs, utilities, healthcare, manufacturing, correctional facilities, and government agencies. Reference projects include power systems for Temple University, Waupaca Foundry, the Hampden County Sheriff’s Department, and Renaissance. Enercon also serves OEMs through contract manufacturing and provides field service, commissioning, and parts support nationwide.

Enercon emphasizes complete in-house control over design, fabrication, and testing to ensure quality, safety, and performance standards. The company states that its integrated manufacturing process and comprehensive testing facilities guarantee every system is precision-built and rigorously validated before deployment.
